rationale: The agent verified the user by full name and zip code, matched to a single account, and worked only on that user’s orders. It looked up the relevant order and product details before acting. The agent requested explicit confirmation of the exact exchanges, first for the desk lamp and then for the water bottle, and did not perform any write until both items were confirmed. When the initially chosen bottle variant was unavailable, the agent correctly reported that and requested another choice. The final exchange call returned without error, and the agent provided a reasonable confirmation message. No actions were taken without confirmation, no data was fabricated beyond tool-supported options, and no policy constraints were violated. Minor ambiguity in the tool’s response formatting does not indicate a failure, as the exchange API did not return an error.
